properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Lists After (days)
properties.description: A kept list that its slot has not used for this many days is removed (a track you deleted). 0: never.

properties.name: slideMax
properties.title: Max Slides
properties.description: Maximum number of images in the slideshow. Zero for 'unlimited'.

properties.name: listMode
properties.title: Slides in a List
properties.description: For a data source with a real list (a feed, a folder). continue: each visit goes on where the last one stopped, and the list is fetched again when it is used up. restart: every visit starts at the top of a new list.

properties.name: refreshHours
properties.title: Fetch Again After (hours)
properties.description: With continue: how old the list may get before it is fetched again, even when some is left. 0: only when it is used up.

properties.name: showAs
properties.title: Show As
properties.description: auto: as the data source says (a text page overrides, a picture is a background). background: the overlays are drawn on it. blend: washes over the page before it, without the overlays. override: covers everything (only a priority image is drawn over it).
